definitions.explanation: The act of coughing, or the sound produced by coughing. A common symptom of colds and respiratory illness.

examples.japanese: {咳|せき}が{止|と}まらなくて{辛|つら}い。
examples.english: My cough won't stop and it's miserable.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}の{中|なか}で{咳|せき}をするときは、マスクをするか{手|て}で{口|くち}を{覆|おお}いましょう。
examples.english: When coughing on the train, wear a mask or cover your mouth with your hand.

notes:
{咳|せき} refers to the act or sound of coughing. A common symptom discussed when talking about colds and illness.

KEY EXPRESSIONS:
- {咳|せき}が{出|で}る: to have a cough (literally "a cough comes out" — the standard way to say it)
- {咳|せき}をする: to cough (deliberate action)
- {咳|せき}が{止|と}まらない: can't stop coughing

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {咳|せき}{止|ど}め: cough medicine/suppressant
- {空咳|からぜき}: dry cough (no phlegm)
- {咳|せき}エチケット: cough etiquette (covering mouth, wearing mask)
- {咳払|せきばら}い: clearing one's throat (often to get attention)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, wearing a mask when coughing in public is strongly expected as a matter of etiquette ({咳|せき}エチケット). Not doing so can draw disapproval.

HOMOPHONE:
Do not confuse with {席|せき} (seat/place) — same reading, different kanji.
